description: Three utility sections: an inverter with two rectifiers, an analogue maximum and minimum, and a sample and hold with its own noise source

inputs.text: The signal the inverter and the two rectifiers work on
One of the two signals the logic section compares; an unpatched input counts as 0V, so a single signal has its positive half on MAX and its negative half on MIN
The signal the sample and hold reads; with nothing patched here it samples the internal noise source, giving a random voltage at each trigger
A rising edge past 0.7V makes the sample and hold take a fresh reading

outputs.text: The input signal with its sign flipped
The input signal with everything below 0V clipped away
The size of the input signal with its sign discarded, the negative half folded upwards, which doubles the frequency of a symmetrical wave
The greater of the logic section's two inputs, which for gate signals is an OR
The lesser of the logic section's two inputs, which for gate signals is an AND
White noise with a bell-shaped distribution, mostly within -2V to 2V
The voltage read at the last trigger, held until the next one

notes: the module is monophonic: on a polyphonic cable only the first channel is read, and every output carries one channel.
this module has no right-click menu of its own.

continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the module's own white noise.
